description.zh: 富士山是日本最高峰，海拔3,776米，完美的锥形火山轮廓是日本的象征。每年7至8月开放登山，周边的富士五湖提供经典倒影美景。
description.en: At 3,776 m, Mount Fuji is Japan's highest peak. Its perfect conical silhouette is the nation's symbol. Open for climbing July-August; the Fuji Five Lakes provide iconic mirror reflections.

zh: 日本最高峰，3,776米完美锥形火山
7—8月登顶开放，四季各有湖边绝景
en: Japan's highest peak — perfect 3,776 m cone
Summit open July–August; iconic lake views year-round

admission.zh: 登山保全协力金2,000日元（含山梨县侧）

tips.zh: 不登顶也值得来，富士山本宫浅间大社和忍野八海周边风景极佳。登顶建议雇佣向导。
tips.en: Worth visiting even without climbing — Fujisan Hongu Sengen Shrine and Oshino Hakkai offer beautiful close-up views. Hire a guide if summiting.

description.zh: 京都拥有超过1600座寺庙和400座神社，其中金阁寺、清水寺、岚山竹林等最为著名。每年春季赏樱和秋季赏枫时节，吸引数以百万计的游客。
description.en: Kyoto has over 1,600 temples and 400 shrines. Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera and Arashiyama Bamboo Grove are among the most visited. Cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons draw millions.

zh: 四季主题：春樱、夏绿、秋枫、冬雪
金阁寺、清水寺、岚山竹林各具特色
en: Seasonal beauty: cherry blossoms, green summer, autumn foliage, winter snow
Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera and Arashiyama each unmissable

admission.zh: 各寺庙单独收费，一般500—1,000日元

tips.zh: 花见（3月底—4月初）和红叶（11月中）期间人极多，住宿需提前3个月预订。
tips.en: Cherry blossom (late March–early April) and autumn foliage (mid-November) bring enormous crowds; book accommodation 3 months ahead.

description.zh: 涩谷十字路口是全球最繁忙的十字路口之一，每次绿灯约有3,000人同时穿行。周边聚集了东京最前沿的时尚、美食和娱乐，是现代都市文化的缩影。
description.en: Shibuya Crossing is one of the world's busiest intersections — some 3,000 people cross at once on each green light. The surrounding district is Tokyo's epicentre of fashion, food and urban pop culture.

zh: 日均逾100万人次的涩谷十字路口
忠犬八公像，东京最著名的集合地点
涩谷Sky展望台360°俯瞰东京夜景
en: Shibuya Crossing sees over 1 million people daily
Hachiko statue — Tokyo's most famous meeting spot
Shibuya Sky observation deck with 360° night views

admission.zh: 街区免费，涩谷Sky展望台约2,000日元
admission.en: Street free; Shibuya Sky observation deck ~¥2,000

tips.zh: 涩谷十字路口最佳观景点是涩谷站二楼星巴克或对面的 Mag's Park 观景台，无需消费。
tips.en: The best free vantage point for the crossing is the second-floor Starbucks in Shibuya Station or the Mag's Park terrace opposite.

description.zh: 广岛和平纪念公园见证了二战的历史教训；乘船15分钟可达的宫岛岛上，严岛神社的朱红大鸟居矗立于海中，是日本三景之一。
description.en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park bears witness to the lessons of WWII. A 15-minute ferry brings you to Miyajima island, where Itsukushima Shrine's vermilion torii gate rises from the sea — one of Japan's Three Views.

location.zh: 广岛县广岛市及廿日市市

zh: 广岛和平纪念馆：原爆穹顶UNESCO遗产
宫岛严岛神社海中大鸟居
退潮可步行至鸟居脚下近距离观看
en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial and A-Bomb Dome UNESCO site
Itsukushima Shrine's torii gate rising from the sea
At low tide you can walk right up to the gate

admission.zh: 和平纪念馆200日元，宫岛神社免费

tips.zh: 出发前查看宫岛潮汐表，退潮时段才能走到鸟居旁边。牡蛎和枫叶馒头是当地必尝美食。
tips.en: Check tide tables before going — only at low tide can you approach the torii on foot. Try the local oysters and momiji manju (maple-leaf cakes).

description.zh: 大阪城是日本最著名的城堡之一，16世纪由丰臣秀吉主持修建。高达58米的天守阁俯瞰大片樱花园，内部设有展示日本统一历史的博物馆。
description.en: Osaka Castle is one of Japan's most famous castles, built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the 16th century. The 58 m keep overlooks extensive cherry-blossom gardens and houses a museum on Japan's unification.

zh: 1583年丰臣秀吉始建，日本最著名城堡之一
天守阁内日本统一历史博物馆
护城河外约600棵樱花树春季盛开
en: Built 1583 by Toyotomi Hideyoshi; Japan's most iconic castle
Museum inside the keep chronicles Japan's unification
~600 cherry trees in the outer grounds bloom each spring

admission.zh: 天守阁600日元，外围公园免费

tips.zh: 城堡公园本身免费开放，樱花季节在外围野餐非常惬意，无需进入天守阁。
tips.en: The castle park itself is free. During cherry blossom season, a picnic in the outer grounds is the quintessential experience — no need to enter the keep.
